name: web-security-feature-sections-holographic-card-and-vault-door
title: Security Sections: Holographic Card and Vault Door
whatItIs: A collage of three dark and light panels for a bank's security messaging: a hand holding a holographic credit card on grey, a black panel 'Enterprise Grade Security for Everyday Banking' with pill feature tags, and a black and white photograph of an open bank vault door with 'Bank-Level Protection' and pills.
whatItMeans: A vault photo is an instant metaphor for security, and a tiny rainbow sheen on the card is the only colour.
techniques: Black and white vault photo as a metaphor

vocabulary.definition: A picture that stands for an idea, like a vault for security.
A rainbow-like reflective gradient on a surface.
